3 Bedroom + Maid Villa for Rent | Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club – The Residences

Provident Real Estate proudly presents this exclusive 3-bedroom + maid villa in the prestigious Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club, designed for polo enthusiasts, greenery lovers, and quiet-luxury lifestyle seekers.

Set on a large plot with a peaceful back view, this single-row villa offers privacy, space, and refined living in one of Dubai Land’s most sought-after resort-style communities, which also features a luxurious 5-star hotel at its core.

Property Details:

3 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
4 Bathrooms
Built-Up Area: 3,370.83 Sq. Ft.
Large Plot with serene back view
Single Row for maximum privacy
Spacious open-plan living & dining
Premium finishes and thoughtfully designed layout
2 Covered parking spaces
Vacant & ready to move in

Community Highlights:

Championship polo fields & Polo Academy
Equestrian stables & professional riding school
Lush green landscapes & serene surroundings
5-Star hotel within the community
Paddle & tennis courts
Swimming pools & fully equipped gyms
Pilates studio & wellness facilities
Luxury spa & beauty salon
Licensed restaurants, lounges & boutique retail

Lifestyle Overview:

This villa is a rare opportunity for those who value calm sophistication, green spaces, and resort-style living. Enjoy world-class polo, serene greenery, and luxury hotel amenities at your doorstep — a lifestyle reserved for the few who seek the extraordinary.
